env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd repro

# The external test imports its sibling package, and the inactive
# //go:build engines test file forces a variant eject under
# tags=engines. The variant helper must resolve the test-only import;
# before the fix it failed with "cannot find package" and eject
# exited 1.
logos eject -o out
exists out/p/p.go
exists out/p/p_test.go
exists out/p/engines_test.go
exists out/helper/helper.go
grep '^//go:build engines' out/p/engines_test.go

cd out
go test ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go test ./...

-- repro/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectrepro

go 1.27

-- repro/p/p.lgo --
package p

const Value = 1

-- repro/helper/helper.lgo --
package helper

const Value = 1

-- repro/p/p_test.lgo --
package p_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/ejectrepro/helper"
	"example.com/ejectrepro/p"
)

func TestValue(t *testing.T) {
	if got := p.Value; got != helper.Value {
		t.Fatalf("Value = %d, want %d", got, helper.Value)
	}
}

-- repro/p/engines_test.lgo --
//go:build engines

package p_test
